name: Mythic Trial by Fire
body:
The spell heals a target whose alignment is within one step of your deity’s by the same amount it would be otherwise damaged.

Augmented (3rd): If you expend two uses of mythic power, the spell affects all creatures in a 30 ft.-radius.
